title: Resume + portfolio content refresh (merge projects, Tech Lead, infra)
description:
Background
- We maintain clean resume copies in `resume/en.md` and `resume/vi.md`, and the website content in `data/portfolio.ts`.
- Repo convention says `resume/vi-raw.md` is the source of truth for detailed info; it is currently missing and should be introduced.

Goals
- Merge and tighten experience/project entries based on latest notes (Freelance merge; Onschool SRM+Student Management merge; add infra contribution for SLC).
- Make Tech Lead scope explicit (SLC = current; SRM = later phase).
- Keep clean resumes concise and professional; remove overly business/domain narrative and keep tech/approach impact.
- Keep all sources consistent: `resume/en.md`, `resume/vi.md`, `resume/vi-raw.md`, `data/portfolio.ts` (site + resume page).

Decisions already made (2026-03-23)
- Freelance: merge “Financial Management Platform” + “Skeleton Platform (Low-Code)” under heading “Financial Management Platform”; keep bullets similar to EAV/DDD/NATS/lazy-loading; remove domain-heavy description.
- Onschool: keep heading “SRM System” but rename to “SRM System (Student Management)” and fold Student Management System content into it; add debug/tracing + avoid N+1 query highlight.
- Student Life Cycle: add infra/bootstrap bullet(s): scripts/config/postgres, runable by README.
- Add Tech Lead labels everywhere (English + Vietnamese + `data/portfolio.ts`).
- Create minimal `resume/vi-raw.md` and then sync.

Non-goals
- No claims that cannot be backed by actual experience.
- No inclusion of internal-only projects marked “khong nen dua vao CV”.

Deliverables
- Updated content sources + cross-source QA checklist completed.
close_reason: Resume and portfolio content refresh completed end-to-end
